import ast, hashlib, json, platform, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
payload = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
for name in ("controller", "workflow"):
    item = payload[name]
    body = item["text"].encode("utf-8")
    assert len(body) == item["bytes"], name + " length mismatch"
    assert hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() == item["sha256"], name + " digest mismatch"
source = payload["controller"]["text"]
tree = ast.parse(source, filename=payload["controller"]["blob"] + ".py", mode="exec")
compile(tree, filename=payload["controller"]["blob"] + ".py", mode="exec", dont_inherit=True)
functions = [{"name": node.name, "line": node.lineno, "end_line": node.end_lineno} for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))]
imports = [{"line": node.lineno, "text": ast.get_source_segment(source, node)} for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom))]
workflow = payload["workflow"]["text"]
python_blocks = []
rows = workflow.splitlines()
for i, row in enumerate(rows):
    if "python3 -B - <<'PY'" not in row:
        continue
    indent = len(row) - len(row.lstrip())
    end = next(j for j in range(i + 1, len(rows)) if rows[j].strip() == "PY")
    code = "\n".join(r[indent:] for r in rows[i+1:end]) + "\n"
    node = ast.parse(code, filename=payload["workflow"]["blob"] + ".yml:embedded-python")
    compile(node, filename=payload["workflow"]["blob"] + ".yml:embedded-python", mode="exec", dont_inherit=True)
    python_blocks.append({"start_line": i+2, "end_line": end, "bytes": len(code.encode("utf-8")), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(code.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(), "status": "parse_and_compile_passed_without_execution"})
assert len(python_blocks) == 1, "Unexpected workflow embedded Python count"
print(json.dumps({
    "schema_version": 1,
    "status": "passed",
    "scope": "root_actual_memory_only_AST_parse_and_compile",
    "utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "interpreter": sys.version,
    "platform": platform.platform(),
    "controller": {k: payload["controller"][k] for k in ("blob", "bytes", "sha256")},
    "workflow": {k: payload["workflow"][k] for k in ("blob", "bytes", "sha256")},
    "controller_function_inventory": functions,
    "controller_import_inventory": imports,
    "embedded_python_blocks": python_blocks,
    "candidate_module_imported": False,
    "candidate_code_executed": False,

}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
